title: Replication materials for Evaluating coverage and novelty in technology intelligence

creators.name: Zhang, Junjie
creators.affiliation: Shanghai Academy of Global Governance & Area Studies; School of Economics and Finance, Shanghai International Studies University, Shanghai 201620, China

description: Research software and patent-derived archival replication data for the TASM manuscript Evaluating coverage and novelty in technology intelligence. Software is MIT; derived archival data, original figures and documentation are CC BY 4.0. The input source is the United States Patent and Trademark Office release through 31 December 2024, source DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15058362. The source DOI is not a DOI for this research release. Frozen-input replay, forecasting reconstruction and full raw-source reconstruction are distinct layers. The 2022 extension remains unexecuted. No funding, competing interests, human participants or ethics-approval claim is made. The author will personally activate Zenodo-GitHub archiving and publish a GitHub Release.
notes: Mixed open licenses: MIT for original research software; CC BY 4.0 for patent-derived data, author-created figures and documentation. Review repository LICENSE, DATA_LICENSE.md and SOURCE_ATTRIBUTION.md. No study DOI is preassigned.
